note: Alberta Parks recreation area on the channel joining the two parts of Buffalo Lake, ~40 km west of Stettler, operated by the Summer Village of Rochon Sands. Only the sites along the channel road (about 5-7, 48-51 and 53-58) are on the water; the main loop is back in the trees. The channel is good for shore fishing and paddling. Firewood for sale. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Alberta Parks page (updated Apr 20, 2026), the Rochon Sands fees page and the 2026 campground guide map: 61 unserviced FCFS sites C$28 (cash/cheque envelopes or OptionPay online), non-potable pump; sites/hookups/facilities written (were absent); season May 9 - Oct 14 (was approximate). Lakefront confirmed for the channel-road sites; the loop sites are not on the water.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakefront CONFIRMED (stored lakefront), for the sites on the channel road. Imagery at ~0.33 m/px around 52.4505,-113.0590: the campground road follows the channel's south bank 5-30 m from the water across a grassy bank with scattered shrubs. Two pull-ins run from the road to the waterline (~52.4505,-113.0587 and ~52.4510,-113.0577), and the pads at the east end (~52.4515,-113.0545) sit beside the channel. The 2026 guide map places the road-side sites along the bank: 48-51 and 5-7 (6 is the host) on the south bank, 53-58 on the west arm. Loop sites 8-47 and 1-4 lie 60-150 m back in aspen/spruce. If the reviewer wants a caveat: 'Only the sites along the channel road are on the water; the main loop is in the trees.' The site placement is from the guide map, so the numbers are approximate.
